facts.statement: Bixies that normally help on the Queensfields farm stopped working and took their own queen captive deep inside their beehive, injuring Sunflower.
facts.quote: They have stopped working and, even worse, taken their own queen captive deep inside their beehive!

article_summaries.title: Meet Sunflower
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news post (captured January 2010) introducing the NPC Sunflower, foreman of farming in Queensfields. It explains that Bixies who normally help on the farm have turned against the work and taken their queen captive in their hive, injuring Sunflower, and it tells players where to find him. The article gives no date, only a relative 'published about 1 week, 4 days ago' stamp.
